### An Unexpected Way To Set Your Life on the Path of Godly Wisdom This Year
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-january-5-2023.html
Passage: Proverbs 13:20
Points:
- Focusing on small daily choices and habits fosters wisdom more effectively than major resolutions.
- Thriving relationships require intentional action and boundaries rather than accepting relational dysfunction.
- Walking closely with wise individuals guides personal growth, while foolish company causes harm.
- Evaluating our own actions and reactions must come before assessing the behavior of others.
- Healthy boundaries protect our peace and safety while still allowing us to love others well.

### What Is the Meaning of the Proverb, 'Hope Deferred Makes the Heart Sick'?
Author: Jennifer Heeren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-is-the-meaning-of-the-proverb-hope-deferred-makes-the-heart-sick.html
Passage: Proverbs 13:12
Points:
- Prolonged delays and unfulfilled longings expose our underlying doubts and struggle for control.
- Impatience during waiting periods tempts us to pursue human schemes instead of trusting God.
- Extended seasons of waiting can refine character and draw believers into deeper dependence on the Lord.
- Surrendering our timing and expectations to God guards the heart from growing bitter.
- True peace and fulfilled desire arrive as we cling closely to God through persistent prayer.
